text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government decision to raise custom duty on imported cars faces wide opposition.
- Parlimentary committee to prepare draft law on new public sector payscale by Monday.
- Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri: We reject the advice of the World Bank. Covering deficit can be achieved by ending squandering.
- More evacuees from Brazzaville to arrive in Beirut.
- Bank share active, Solidere shares steady on the Beirut exchange.
- President Elias Hrawi: Lebanon insists on making Israel pay for damage resulting from its shelling of U.N. base at Qana in south Lebanon last year.
- Foreign Minsiter Faris Bouez receives letter from Presdident of Congo Brazzaville.
- Lebanon to establish $350 million company to build roads.
- Israel shells eastern and central sectors of south Lebanon.
